remarks: Discover the perfect blend of modern updates and timeless charm in this beautiful condo located in Chesterfield, one of Stamford's most desirable, convenient and pet-friendly complexes. From the moment you step inside this 2nd floor unit, you'll be greeted by soaring ceilings, skylights, hardwood floors and an abundance of natural light. The wood-burning fireplace in the living room creates a warm and cozy ambiance, perfect for relaxing evenings. The completely remodeled kitchen has been thoughtfully designed with high-end stainless appliances, granite countertops and custom cabinetry, making it a dream for home chefs. Adjoining dining room is spacious enough to entertain and add elegance to your gatherings, with a step-out balcony overlooking the courtyard. The tastefully remodeled baths offer contemporary finishes and high-end fixtures. Storage is never an issue with 3 custom designed closets, ensuring everything has its place. Plus, the huge attic provides additional room for seasonal items and extra belongings. Packed with upgrades including new kitchen appliances and washer/dryer, recently installed siding, skylights and roof, and replacement windows and doors, offering peace of mind for years to come. The complex has two swimming pools, plenty of sidewalks for walking, jogging, dog walking, and 24-hour security. Its prime location offers easy access to nearby stores, restaurants, and essential services, ensuring convenience is always within reach.
